The slide sets the arithmetic out in full inside DETAIL A, and the frame re-derives it at render time in window.__akAssert with actual computed from the drawing's own SAMPLE constant rather than typed, so the number is proven by the picture that carries it. It is declared here rather than as a count because no claim states 33 and the gate's count kind wants one member per unit.
